{{Otheruses|Thorn}}
A '''thornbush''', or '''thorn bush''', was a type of plant that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]] and [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].

Thornbushes also grew on the [[Combat Moon]] in the [[Ishanna system/Legends|Ishanna system]].<ref name="CM">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>

{{Flora-stub}}
